Our buyers are psychiatrists who respond to clinical credibility, ROI clarity, and intelligence Comfort with long sales cycles and cash-pay ROI conversations with practice owners Startup mindset: resourceful, persistent, and energized by ambiguity Why Join Ampa? Rooted in courage, empowerment, and integrity, we've pioneered solutions that transform the world's wellness brands into revenue-generating machines. Highly-driven self starters, who are motivated by growth opportunities and the drive to excel in sales.
Knowledge, background, or raw passion around health and wellness.
